title: 1.2 Biology and Technology
description: Benefits of biology to technology and uses of technology in biology

questions.question: Biology is defined as the study of ____.
options: the physical features of the earth and its atmosphere
the production of devices and tools for scientific investigations
life: the structures, functions, growth, origins, evolution and distribution of living organisms
the interaction of humans with the natural environment
questions.correctAnswer: life: the structures, functions, growth, origins, evolution and distribution of living organisms

questions.question: Technology is defined as ____.
options: the study of living organisms from the simplest to the most complex
the application of scientific knowledge, skills, methods and processes for the production of devices and tools for scientific investigations
the use of biological systems to develop useful products
the management of natural resources for human benefit
questions.correctAnswer: the application of scientific knowledge, skills, methods and processes for the production of devices and tools for scientific investigations

questions.question: The blend of biology and technology forms ____.
Biotechnology is a technology that utilizes ____ to develop useful products.
Which of the following is an example of biotechnology given in the textbook?
options: Using solar panels to generate electricity
Using yeasts to produce bread and beer
questions.correctAnswer: Using yeasts to produce bread and beer

questions.question: Biotechnology is the integration of ____ sciences.
Many biochemical substances in plants have been used to develop ____.
Scientists have imitated the nature of human, animal and plant genes for ____.
options: gene engineering and the creation of biosynthetic materials
questions.correctAnswer: gene engineering and the creation of biosynthetic materials

questions.question: Gene engineering is used to ____.
Biosynthetic materials are created to ____.
In section 1.2.1, engineers imitated the mound architecture of ____ to design buildings with chimneys.
The noses of bullet trains were designed by imitating the shape of ____ when they dive into water.
The uses of technology in biology are ____.
options: the study of the distribution of species through geological periods
the ways in which technological tools are applied to solve various human problems
the imitation of nature to design new products
the production of yeast for bread and beer
questions.correctAnswer: the ways in which technological tools are applied to solve various human problems

questions.question: Biochemical studies are helpful to investigate information on ____.
options: the chemical components of medicinal plants
the distribution of species in ecosystems
the movement of populations across landscapes
carbohydrates, proteins, lipids and nucleic acids
questions.correctAnswer: carbohydrates, proteins, lipids and nucleic acids

questions.question: Biomedical studies deal with providing detailed information on ____.
options: the chemical components of medicinal plants
carbohydrates, proteins, lipids and nucleic acids
the interactions of humans with the environment
questions.correctAnswer: the chemical components of medicinal plants

questions.question: Biophysical studies gather biological information at ____ scales of biological organization.
Bioinformatics is a discipline involving ____ to collect, store, analyze and disseminate biological data.
Biogeographical information is the study of ____.
options: the chemical composition of medicinal plants
the metabolic processes of cancer cells
the structure of carbohydrates and lipids
the distribution of species along with geographic ecosystems through geological periods
questions.correctAnswer: the distribution of species along with geographic ecosystems through geological periods

questions.question: A digital thermometer is an instrument used for measuring ____.
A pregnancy urine test works by detecting the amount of ____.
In a pregnancy test, HCG is produced in the ____ around six to ten days after fertilization.
In a pregnancy urine test, a result showing two lines confirms ____.
options: a negative result with no pregnancy

questions.question: The diabetic blood test is a tool used to measure the level of ____.
An HIV test is a detector used to ____.
Microscopes are technological tools used to ____.
A Computed Tomography (CT) scan is ____.
options: a device used to measure body fat
a tool for collecting geographical data
a sophisticated x-ray technology used to take many x-ray pictures of the body
questions.correctAnswer: a sophisticated x-ray technology used to take many x-ray pictures of the body

questions.question: A Positron Emission Tomography (PET) scan uses ____.
options: a special dye containing radioactive tracers
a magnet to align body cells
questions.correctAnswer: a special dye containing radioactive tracers

questions.question: GPS is a device used to collect ____.
options: blood sugar readings from the fingertip
the amount of HCG in urine
biogeographical information on landscape mapping, plants, animals and human movements
questions.correctAnswer: biogeographical information on landscape mapping, plants, animals and human movements

questions.question: According to the unit summary, biology is dependent on technology in terms of using devices, likewise technology is dependent on biology in terms of ____.
options: identifying scientific information and imitating biotechnological devices from nature
questions.correctAnswer: identifying scientific information and imitating biotechnological devices from nature

questions.question: Biotechnology achieves the application of organisms, cells, parts and ____ for products and services.
Biology is a source of materials that enable us to imitate, design, adapt and develop modern technologies and ____.
The diversity of nature stimulates the ____.
Scientists and engineers imitate nature to innovate, problem solve and ____.
The practical application of biotechnological instruments provides required human services and ____.
Environmental studies is a multidisciplinary system dealing with ____.
options: the interactions of humans with the environment
the sum of techniques used in service delivery
the production of yeast for bread
the classification of animals into vertebrates
questions.correctAnswer: the interactions of humans with the environment

questions.question: Bioinformatics collects, stores, analyzes and disseminates biological data such as ____.
HCG is produced in the placenta around ____ after fertilization.
In a pregnancy urine test, a single line is a control line showing ____.
The diabetic blood test takes the blood sample from the ____.
In a PET scan, the special dye containing radioactive tracers is swallowed, inhaled, or ____.
A PET scan visualizes and measures changes in metabolic processes and physiological activities like ____.
options: blood flow, chemical composition, and absorption
hair color, eye color, and skin tone
reading speed, writing speed, and typing speed
questions.correctAnswer: blood flow, chemical composition, and absorption

questions.question: A CT scan is used to detect and screen for a variety of ____.
According to the unit summary, biotechnological devices are tools used to solve day-to-day biological tasks and ____.
options: support the discovery of more information in the course of biological studies
replace all living organisms in nature
prevent students from doing laboratory work
reduce the need for biological knowledge
questions.correctAnswer: support the discovery of more information in the course of biological studies

questions.question: Biotechnology is the use of biology to develop new products, methods and organisms intended to ____.
The system of manufacturing biological elements is ____.
The sum of techniques, skills and processes used in the production or delivery of services is ____.
Computer Information Technology Scanning (CITS) is a device used for investigating information on ____.
options: diseases or cancerous areas of the human body
the distribution of species across ecosystems
questions.correctAnswer: diseases or cancerous areas of the human body

questions.question: The handheld body fat calculator device is used to measure ____.
